iran_nuclear.name: Iran Nuclear
iran_nuclear.notes: Day 48. CRITICAL: IAEA CONFIRMS Iran has NOT allowed access to bombed nuclear facilities. IAEA CANNOT verify if enrichment suspended. Stockpile could allow 10 bombs per IAEA chief Grossi. JINSA report: Iran evicted IAEA inspectors from most sites. Fordow status unknown. 440kg 60% enriched uranium unaccounted for. Islamabad talks failed - nuclear dismantlement was key sticking point. Technical: CRITICAL. Probability UP to 30%. Rising.

iran_conventional.notes: Day 48. CRITICAL ESCALATION: US-Iran Islamabad talks FAILED after 21+ hours (Apr 12-13). US Navy blockade of ALL Iranian ports ACTIVE since 10am ET Apr 13. Trump says Iranian ships will be 'eliminated'. Iran threatens no Gulf port safe. Oil Brent ~$112+, spot as high as $141. UK Starmer does NOT support blockade. CENTCOM says won't impede non-Iranian Hormuz transit. Rhetoric: CRITICAL. Mobilization: CRITICAL. Probability UP to 65%. Rising sharply.

israel_lebanon.name: Israel-Lebanon
israel_lebanon.notes: Day 48. ESCALATING: Israel EXTENDS ground operations in southern Lebanon. Lebanese Red Cross offices in Tyre hit by drone. Israel REJECTS ceasefire with Hezbollah ahead of Washington talks next week. 1,500+ killed, 1M displaced. Hezbollah paused attacks but Israel continues. Lebanon president seeking Paris/Riyadh/Washington pressure on Israel. Pope Leo demands ceasefire. Probability UP to 35%. Rising.

turkey.name: Turkey
turkey.notes: STABLE: Roketsan opened LARGEST defense production facilities in Turkish history. Tayfun Block 4 hypersonic missile entering serial production 2026. FM Fidan warns arms race if Iran develops weapons. NATO missile interceptions of Iranian missiles over Turkish airspace. Technical: HIGH. Probability 15%. Stable.

india.name: India-Pakistan
india.notes: WATCH: CFR survey warns India-Pakistan armed conflict likely in 2026 due to heightened terrorist activity. Indian Navy was minutes away from sea strike during Operation Sindoor. Drivers of conflict remain intact. Pakistan mediating Iran ceasefire simultaneously. Probability 24%. Stable.

russia.name: Russia (Nuclear Signaling)
russia.notes: Day 53. ESCALATING: Medvedev nuclear threats continue. Russia reveling in Trump NATO attacks. Iran war windfall: billions in oil revenues, sanctions easing. NATO strained by US-European rift. NATO frontline states welcoming nuclear cooperation with France. Russia shaping narrative ahead of 2026 NPT Review. GLOBSEC: Russia preparing for major war, window shrinking. Probability UP to 62%. Rising.

china.name: China
china.notes: ESCALATING: US intelligence (CNN/Bloomberg) indicates China preparing to deliver MANPADS/air defense systems to Iran within weeks. Trump threatens 50% tariffs on China. China denies. Xi told KMT chair China will ABSOLUTELY NOT TOLERATE Taiwan independence. PLA Eastern Theater Type 055 destroyers live-fire drill complete. Xi military purges leave him powerful but isolated. Wang visited NK - strengthening strategic communication. Technical: CRITICAL. Probability UP to 28%. Rising.

north_korea.name: North Korea
north_korea.notes: Day 48. SUSTAINED: 3 consecutive days of major weapon tests (Apr 6-8) including cluster-bomb warhead ballistic missiles. Top diplomat repeats SK is 'most hostile enemy state'. Constitutional nuclear status irreversible. Global distraction from Iran war gives NK cover. ICBM and tactical nukes deployed. Probability 85%. Stable at critical level.

russia_ukraine.name: Russia-Ukraine
russia_ukraine.notes: War Year 4, Day 1150+. SUSTAINED: Ukraine drone advantage stalling Russian advances - 115 mid-range strikes March (up from 41 Jan). Russia regenerating tank force (Janes). Civilian/POW exchanges Apr 11. Russia maintains expansive territorial goals. Iran war windfall: oil revenues surging. New START expired Feb 2026. Probability 80%. Stable at high level.

pakistan_afghanistan.name: Pakistan-Afghanistan
pakistan_afghanistan.notes: ESCALATING: Pakistan declared OPEN WAR on Afghan Taliban regime. China-mediated ceasefire talks in Urumqi - Apr 8 both sides agreed to 'explore comprehensive solution'. Fighting continues worst since Taliban returned 2021. Eid ceasefire collapsed. Mortars killing civilians including children. Pakistan simultaneously mediating Iran ceasefire. Probability UP to 22%. Rising.
